infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Reads your weight, body composition and Apple Watch sessions from Apple Health, so your charts and trends stay complete.
infoPlist.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Writes your finished sessions back to Apple Health, so other apps see the training you logged here. Only if you turn it on.
